subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Dinner
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our annual Employee Appreciation Dinner is scheduled for next month. The event will be held at the Grand Ballroom of the Hilton Hotel, where we will recognize and celebrate the hard work and dedication of our employees. Please mark your calendars and RSVP by the end of the week. We look forward to sharing this special evening with all of you. Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
